messages:
Priya: FYI vendor invoice shows a $3.9k delta tied to a partner pilot where compute was billed under partner-project but some jobs ran on our sandbox pool. Need to reconcile before we bill partner credits.

cost-bot: ALERT: Cross-project GPU usage detected (2024-10-12). Potential partner-pass-through: $3,900. See /alerts/1993.

Maya: Can we get instance-level join to prove which hours were partner-customer facing vs internal? Jon, can you run the join with provisioning tags?

Jon: Query I ran:
```sql
SELECT be.instance_id, be.project_id, be.cost, inv.owner_service, inv.tags
FROM `billing.export` be
LEFT JOIN `inventory.instances` inv ON be.instance_id = inv.id
WHERE be.usage_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND CURRENT_DATE()
  AND (be.project_id LIKE '%partner-%' OR inv.tags LIKE '%partner_pilot%')
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
Top rows: instance-9001 project partner-pilot-a cost $1,800 inv.owner_service=sandbox-operator tags=NULL
instance-9012 project partner-pilot-b cost $1,200 inv.owner_service=partner-orchestrator tags=partner_pilot
instance-9123 project sandbox-utils cost $900 inv.owner_service=sandbox-operator tags=NULL

Ruchi: Sales confirms partner jobs should have run under partner-orchestrator only. Anything provisioned by sandbox-operator is internal. Looks like two partner-ticketed jobs were routed via sandbox.

Priya: Proposal: (1) we credit partner for instances verified partner_orchestrator=true and (2) absorb internal sandbox portion as internal trial cost. Approval: I can sign credits up to $5k.

Maya: Agree. Jon please produce CSV proof (instance_id, start, end, provisioning logs link) and attach to FIN-4219. Exclude anything with customer= or partner= labels in doubt.

Jon: Will run backfill for last 14 days and upload CSV to FIN-4219 by EOD. Also recommend we add a routing guard so partner pilot jobs get a hard label `billing_scope=partner` at submission time.

Ruchi: I'll add a quick check in the partner onboarding playbook and notify the partner that we found mixing; we will credit them for validated partner usage.

cost-bot: NOTE: Partner-pass-through detector scheduled nightly at 02:45 UTC.

Priya: Action items: Jon to upload CSV (EOD), Ruchi to update partner playbook (tomorrow), Maya to log the credit and close FIN-4219 after CSV review. Keep updates here. :white_check_mark:
